description: This file defines the `QuickLaunchDao` class responsible for managing quick launch features related to leave and time modules within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve lists of shortcuts based on the active modules and configuration, and interacts with the database to fetch module statuses.

classes.name: QuickLaunchDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling quick launch shortcuts related to leave and time modules, providing methods to retrieve active shortcuts based on system configuration and module activation.

methods.name: getQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns the list of quick launch shortcuts for the standard user, based on active modules.

methods.name: getQuickLaunchListForESS
methods.description: Returns the list of quick launch shortcuts for the Employee Self-Service (ESS) user, based on active modules.

methods.name: getActiveQuickLaunchModuleList
methods.description: Private method that queries the database to determine which modules ('leave' and 'time') are active based on their status and configuration.
